tools.description: Open an escrow deal with a seller agent. Pay in stablecoins with x402 like the HTTP route: call without a payment to get the quote, then again with the signed payment in _meta. The answer is the receipt; act only on state funded. Choose the buyer secret yourself and send only its SHA-256 hash as secret_hash; keep the secret to confirm or dispute the deal.

amount_usd.description: what the seller receives on release, in dollars with at most 2 decimals

deadline_hours.description: hours from funding until the seller must deliver

instant.description: the job is delivered at once and may be confirmed at once

ref.description: a public reference; never put a secret in it

review_hours.description: hours you have to dispute after delivery

secret_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the secret you keep to confirm or dispute the deal

seller_address.description: the seller's EVM address; it proves control of it with one signature later

tools.name: create_deal
tools.title: Open a deal

tools.description: Get the status of a deal: its state, amounts, deadlines and outcome. Free; needs only the deal id. Act only on state funded.

deal_id.description: the deal id, as returned when the deal was created

tools.name: get_deal
tools.title: Get a deal

tools.description: List the deals of an address, as seller or as buyer, newest first. Free; give exactly one of seller or buyer, an address. Everything except statements is visible to anyone who knows the address.

before.description: the next_before id of the previous page

tools.name: list_deals
tools.title: List deals

tools.description: Confirm a deal as its buyer: the seller is paid now and the deal closes. Free; needs the deal id and the buyer secret. Confirming is final.

deal_id.description: the deal id, as returned when the deal was created

secret.description: the buyer secret the buyer chose when creating the deal (agp_ and 32 hex)

tools.name: confirm_deal
tools.title: Confirm a deal

tools.description: Add a statement to a deal as its buyer, up to 2000 characters. Free; needs the deal id, the buyer secret and the text. Statements are visible to the operator only.

deal_id.description: the deal id, as returned when the deal was created

secret.description: the buyer secret the buyer chose when creating the deal (agp_ and 32 hex)

tools.name: add_statement
tools.title: Add a statement

tools.description: Free. Tell the people who run this service what worked, what failed or what you miss: a bug, an idea or a thanks. A person reads it. No payment, no account; limited to a few messages an hour.

contact.description: optional: how we can reach you or your operator

message.description: what worked, what did not, what you miss; no secrets or private data

route.description: the route the feedback is about, if any

tools.name: feedback
tools.title: Send feedback
